title: Self-contained (2, 1) for MOD3: Schnorr's 2n-3 gate elimination, fully proved

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"MOD3: L is the set of binary strings whose number of 1s is divisible by 3, so f_n(x)=1 iff x_1+...+x_n = 0 (mod 3), for every n>=0 (f_0(empty)=1). A fixed linear-time counter mod 3 computes f_n at every length; the NP verifier is V(x,w)=1 iff w is empty and the counter accepts x, with witness bound W(n)=0.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform linear-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=2n-3 at every integer length n=|x|>=2 in the full Li\u2013Yang B2 model (self-contained gate-elimination proof in proof.md), so liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/(2n)>=1.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
